insights: Kalogirou Real Estate dominates with 389 reviews at 4.8 rating - clear market leader in Larnaca
M.Residence Ltd (2000 ads) has excellent 4.9 rating with 133 reviews - strong Nicosia presence
Doorway Real Estate has perfect 5.0 rating with 105 reviews - exceptional reputation, has mobile number
KAZO despite 2000 ads has only 3.9 rating - volume vs quality disconnect
NCH REAL ESTATE (1498 ads) has only 13 reviews with responsiveness complaints
N.K. SmartAssets (2450 ads) has only 6 reviews - massive gap suggests poor review culture
Century 21 and REMAX benefit from star agents who drive positive reviews
Most agencies have landline numbers only - mobile/WhatsApp contacts rare
